_comment: This is NOT a complete genesis.json — it is a JSON-merge-patch overlay.
Cosmos SDK genesis files are strict proto-JSON: unknown fields inside a
module's params struct fail to unmarshal, so this file cannot itself carry
inline JSON comments (JSON has no comment syntax) or ship as the literal
genesis.json consumed by the binary. Instead it is merged (via jsonmerge,
recursive-merge-objects / replace-leaves) on top of the FULL default
genesis produced by `mantrachaind init` for every registered module.
That default is regenerated fresh from the actual compiled binary every
time — see networks/devnet/README.md for why this file only overrides the
fields Eng2 actually controls, and for the full rationale behind each
value below. This _comment key exists ONLY in this reviewable copy — it
is never valid inside an actual genesis-merge patch (unknown top-level
fields fail strict proto-JSON unmarshalling), so pystarport.json embeds
the same override values without this key. `make devnet-check-genesis-sync`
verifies the two stay identical everywhere except this comment.
Denom note: amantra (18 decimals, DisplayDenom 'mantra') is the CURRENT
compiled default (app/genesis.go, app/params/config.go) inherited from
the v8.4.0 baseline this repo is now pinned to. CONTRIBUTING.md still
lists 'native token name, symbol, and initial allocations' as an open
Day-1 decision — this file reflects what the binary actually does today,
not a claim that amantra/mantra is ArkConstellation's final choice.
app/genesis.go defines NewDefaultGenesisState(), which looks like it's
meant to wire evm.params.evm_denom, a native erc20 token pair, and the
EVM feemarket's base fee to amantra — but it is NEVER CALLED anywhere
in cmd/ (verified: grepped the whole tree, only the definition exists).
`mantrachaind init`'s actual genesis comes from the plain SDK basic-
module-manager default, so evm.params.evm_denom is the raw upstream
default 'aatom', erc20.token_pairs is empty, staking/mint bond/mint
denom are 'stake' - none of it is amantra unless overridden. This file
overrides staking/mint/evm denom fields (unambiguous, required for
internal consistency) but deliberately does NOT try to construct an
erc20 TokenPair or native-precompile entry for amantra - that needs a
real ERC20/precompile address, and erc20types.DefaultGenesisState()
always returns an empty TokenPairs list (verified: x/erc20/types/
genesis.go in the vendored cosmos/evm fork), so
NewDefaultGenesisState()'s `erc20State.TokenPairs[0].Denom = FeeDenom`
would panic on index 0 of an empty slice if it were ever actually
called. Fixing this dead/broken function (or wiring native-precompile
registration correctly) is Eng 1's app/x domain, not something to
improvise a fake contract address for here - see GAPS.md.
feemarket.params.base_fee's raw default (10^9 atto-units, roughly a
'1 gwei' analog at 18 decimals) is a normal EVM gas price and is NOT
overridden - it only looks large as a bare integer.
bank.denom_metadata for amantra is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: the evm
module's InitGenesis calls a coin-info lookup that panics at node
startup ('error initializing evm coin info: denom metadata amantra
could not be found') if this is missing - discovered empirically when
the devnet crash-looped on every node without it.

denom_metadata.description: The native staking and governance token.
denom_metadata.name: Mantra
